correctness.rationale: For a uniform unknown seed and independent homogeneous bond transmission p∈(0,1) on a finite tree, pair reachability yields S_H(p)=1+(2/n)sum_{connected unordered u,v}p^distance, so the effect of deleting edge e is (2/n)F_e(p) with F_e summing crossing pair distances. I independently reconstructed all 18,248 labeled Prüfer trees of orders 2..7, recomputed every edge distance polynomial, selected the score-maximizing edge at p=1/2, and verified nonnegative exact rational degree-(n-1) Bernstein differences against every rival. The particular eight-vertex witness has near-hub minus central score p²(1−2p); pendant scores are strictly dominated. Exhaustiveness is a finite mathematical certificate only through n=7, and its p-uniformity follows from Bernstein positivity, not sampling.
